cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace');sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from wire import *
from harness import run
from canonref import hdr
def vw(val,width): return (([1,2,4,8].index(width)<<(8*width-2))|val).to_bytes(width,'big')
raw=bytes([0xc3])+b'\0\0\0\1'+b'\x01\xaa\x01\xbb'+vw(0,4)+vw(5,8)+bytes(4)+b'\x01'
print('in',raw.hex())
r=run(trace([datagram(raw,(0,))]))['traces'][0]
p=r['packets'][0];exp=hdr('I',0,0,b'\x01')
print(p,r['datagrams'], 'hashok',p['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(exp).hexdigest(),'exp',exp.hex())
# initial with token nonempty overlong len
tok=b'abc'
raw=bytes([0xc0])+b'\0\0\0\1'+b'\x01\xaa\x01\xbb'+vw(3,8)+tok+vw(2,2)+b'\x00\x01'
r=run(trace([datagram(raw,(0,))]))['traces'][0]
p=r['packets'][0];exp=hdr('I',0,0,b'\x01',token=tok)
print('token',p['status'],p['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(exp).hexdigest(),exp.hex())
# H input original width4 canonical min
raw=bytes([0xe3])+b'\0\0\0\1'+b'\x01\xaa\x01\xbb'+vw(5,2)+bytes(4)+b'\x01'
r=run(trace([{'keys':['H']},datagram(raw,(0,))]))['traces'][0]
p=r['packets'][0];exp=hdr('H',0,0,b'\x01')
print('H',p['status'],p['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(exp).hexdigest(),exp.hex())
